title: Halcyon OS 16 on Poco X7 Pro Official Build, Real Test
blurb: Halcyon OS 16 on the Poco X7 Pro — an official Android 16 build, flashed clean, then tested for what works and where it falls short.
video_description:
Halcyon OS 16 on the Poco X7 Pro — an official Android 16 build, flashed clean, then tested for what works and where it falls short.

Official matters here. It means the build comes from the team rather than a random port, and updates are more likely to keep coming. It flashed without drama using the vendor_boot method and a sideload.

The ROM is clean and close to stock Android 16. The notification shade, quick tiles and Google apps all behave the way you'd expect. If you like your Android without a pile of extra skin, this is your lane.

Two honest notes. The Play Store shows as not certified, which can annoy some apps. And customization is lighter than other ROMs — there's no big theming engine to play with. Neither is a dealbreaker, but you should know before you flash.

📱 Device  : POCO X7 Pro (rodin)
🧩 ROM     : Halcyon OS 16 (Official)
🤖 Android : 16

🔬 What Was Tested
• First boot, setup and Google account restore
• Notification shade and quick tiles
• Google apps and Play Store certification
• Customization options out of the box
• General daily feel

📊 Verdict
• Clean, stable Android 16 that boots and behaves.
• Official build, so it's a safer bet than a random port.
• Play Store certification is the one thing to plan around.
• Light on customization — great if you want minimal, plain if you want to theme everything.
